Overview

Kraków is a city in Lesser Poland with a population of 800,653. Poland’s cultural capital, home to the magnificent Wawel Castle, the historic Jewish quarter of Kazimierz, and one of Europe’s best-preserved medieval market squares. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
